question: Which newly found historical rank-separated Illimited Diamond counts have identifiable ore and actual completed-cast denominators, and can any be applied to five assigned current-Retail diamond mappings?
answer: Two previously unindexed original player comment claims provide historical output-rank totals. Neither has a verified zero-inclusive completed-cast denominator or current Retail patch bridge. One identifies R2 Serevite, outside the five assigned Draconium/R1 Serevite exact keys; the other leaves input identity unknown. No current-Retail E or P can be promoted.
